desc: Implement functional graph parsing and reverse adjacency lists for children of each node.
Detect all cycle nodes using indegree peeling and identify each component's cycle.
Implement bottom-up cumulative DP for non-cycle nodes, storing at-most-v counts and merging child arrays into parent arrays modulo 998244353.
For each cycle node, compute the attached-subtree cumulative array from non-cycle children only.
For each component, multiply cycle-node attached arrays over the common cycle value, sum over v=1..M, and multiply component answers modulo 998244353.
Test on the provided samples and edge cases such as self-loops, pure cycles, M=1, and multiple components.
